steps.text: Final composite: 17 rooms after 255 RNG draws (197 in the generator, 58 in the conversion). Drawn relative to the layout's corner; the game then moves the whole level to its place in the act (not drawn, shape unchanged).
calc: Warp (cyan mark): room 1, DS1 wall cells of orientation 10/11 with slot 0, so Levels Vis0 = 35 (Catacombs Level 2) (warps.md, warp slot cell). Entry is by level order: the lower id is taken as the way in. The act's link lists can override Vis at run time (warps.md § C); not modelled here.

Warp (cyan mark): room 17, DS1 wall cells of orientation 10/11 with slot 1, so Levels Vis1 = 37 (Catacombs Level 4) (warps.md, warp slot cell). Exit is by level order: the lower id is taken as the way in. The act's link lists can override Vis at run time (warps.md § C); not modelled here.
Placement shift (maze.md G1): growth never looks at where the level sits in the act; rooms grow freely around the first room, so coordinates can go negative.
At the end the game takes the bounding box of all rooms (x0, y0) and adds (level.x - x0, level.y - y0) to every room, so the box's top-left corner lands on the level's origin in the act map.
It is one translation for all rooms: shape, doors and Defs do not change. This picture is already drawn relative to the box corner, so the shifted level would look the same.
